description: DeepGVS stacking release for VF prediction (CDS + Graph-Mamba, 2146-dim raw features).

release_files.feature_schema.json: Column order for 2146 merged features (1792 protein + 354 CDS).
release_files.preprocess.joblib: FittedSingleStreamPreprocessor bundle (2146 -> 182); must match training MI/PCA.
release_files.nam.pt: NAM meta-learner checkpoint (4 base probabilities -> 2 classes).
release_files.graph_mamba_infer.json: Graph-Mamba on-the-fly inference config (optional; symlink to repo root).

dataset_b.note: Dataset B stacking only; do not mix with Dataset A schema/preprocess at model root.
